title: SeamlessM4T: Massively Multilingual & Multimodal Machine Translation
findings: The paper found that the 'Religion' demographic axis is among the most sensitive to translation quality degradation due to gender bias, for both speech-to-text and speech-to-speech tasks. Added toxicity was also observed in translations related to religion, with the distribution of toxic terms varying across different languages.
